results.name: Gurus Information Technology Services

wrong_claims.what_is_true: The footer reads 'Copyright (c) 2026 Gurus IT Services, LLC. All Rights Reserved', so a current year is present.

results.notes: Site is live and is a single page with anchor-only nav (Home/About/Services/Projects/Clients/Careers/Contact, all '#...'); no sitemap.xml (404), so 'single-page site with no dedicated service pages' holds. Confirmed by DOM inspection: zero ld+json scripts, zero <label> elements, two forms both posting to mail.php with repeated name="name" inputs; phone 732-247-7747 and mali@gurusitservices.com appear as click-to-call/click-to-mail; address on site is 345 Plainfield Ave, Suite 304 & 305, Edison, NJ; 'Get appointment' targets the in-page anchor #getappi and the contact block only offers a date field plus a time <select> inside the mail.php form - no scheduler, no booking engine. At 390 px the header email and phone stack legibly above the logo, so phone_layout 'good' is fair. Google Maps search for 'Gurus IT Services Edison NJ' returned only an unrelated 'Cyber Gurus, LLC' (cybergurus.ai), supporting 'no GBP'. Scores 4/2/4/3 look reasonable for a one-page site with broken form markup and no listings.

wrong_claims.what_is_true: A Birdeye profile carries 4.6 stars from 33 reviews at 5 Brent St (29 five-star, 4 four-star, 2 two-star, 2 one-star), with weekday 9:00-6:00 hours and phone (732) 745-2500 in its LocalBusiness schema. The profile is unclaimed and points to a Google Maps place ID (ChIJvbeuEx_Ew4kRXxf2cVANFko) that no longer resolves to a live Google place.

wrong_claims.what_is_true: There is no owned site, but a public third-party profile publishes an aggregate rating, 33 reviews, address, hours and phone, so a review footprint is visible to search and to assistants even though the Google listing itself is gone.

results.notes: Status: no website found in searches; trading evidence rests on Birdeye/BBB/Bradford White directory records. Google Maps searches by name and by name+address return unrelated plumbers only (NJ Master Sewer, Bob Blaine, Drain Care Pros), so the 'no GBP visible in Maps' claim stands. Gap lowered 5->4 because a 4.6/33-review footprint already exists and only the owned profile and site are missing; evidence stays 2 because everything traceable is an aggregator with no first-party source.

wrong_claims.what_is_true: /contact.cfm embeds a Lawmatics contact form in a visible iframe (app.lawmatics.com/forms/embedded/07fc1780-...), and the page copy tells visitors to fill out the contact form. There is still no scheduler and no document upload.

wrong_claims.claim: Top opportunity evidence: 'Only a one-field search box exists on the page; no contact form fields anywhere'
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The site-wide search box is not the only input: a third-party Lawmatics enquiry form is embedded on the contact page. The real gap is that it is a short generic enquiry form with no probate-specific fields or document upload.

wrong_claims.claim: Operations signal: 'No intake form on the site, so first contact is a phone call during New York business hours'
wrong_claims.what_is_true: A web intake form exists on /contact.cfm, so a prospective client can make first contact without calling.

results.notes: Status: the site is a live New York firm (title 'New York Probate and Estate Litigation Attorneys', tel 212-227-2424, 225 Broadway #1200); an East Brunswick office is still unconfirmed - the only location page in the sitemap is /offices/new-york-city-probate-and-estate-attorneys.cfm and the batch address appears only in third-party directories. The NJ-gap issue stands: no NJ address, phone or town page anywhere in the sitemap or on the home/contact pages. robots.txt is open (only storage/utility paths disallowed). Organization JSON-LD present; copyright reads 2026. Gap lowered 4->3 and evidence raised 2->3 because a working (if thin) intake path was verified in the DOM.

At 390 px the cookie-consent banner covers the lower hero until dismissed, exactly as the record says. robots.txt only blocks admin paths. results.name: Rainbow Plumbing & Heating

wrong_claims.claim: Town pages are missing - East Brunswick appears only in the footer address, so suburb-level searches have nothing to land on
wrong_claims.what_is_true: Town-level pages exist and render: /new-brunswick-plumbing-heating (H1 'Plumbing & Heating Services in New Brunswick, NJ') and /freehold-township-plumbing-heating, alongside county pages for Middlesex, Monmouth and Mercer. What is actually missing is an East Brunswick town page - the town of its own office.

wrong_claims.claim: Top opportunity evidence: 'service-area copy is county-level only with typos'
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The sitemap lists two town-level service-area pages plus three county pages, so 'county-level only' understates the site. The typos ('based our of East Brunswick', 'Monmoth County') are real.

results.notes: Verified in the DOM: Plumber JSON-LD with PostalAddress (197 State Route 18, STE 3000, East Brunswick), geo, telephone (732) 613-7320, email rphnjservice@gmail.com, plus a WebSite block and a FAQPage block (the FAQ entry is malformed - it uses a marketing paragraph as the question). levCustomerAssistantLoader.js from assistant.levitate.ai loads and a 'Chat with our AI assistant' bubble shows on mobile; no scheduler anywhere - the 'Schedule Service' button links to /contact. The /contact form has real labels (First Name, Last name, email, Phone number, Subject, free-text message, opt-in). robots.txt: User-agent * with 'Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes' plus a sitemap line, confirming the record's claim. NAP conflict confirmed: site and schema show (732) 613-7320 while the GBP at 'South Wing, 197 NJ-18 Ste 3000' shows 4.8/36 and (848) 279-8786. At 390 px the phone number and click-to-call icon are prominent, so phone_layout 'good' holds. One caution: page config sets site.widget.form.captcha.type = 'g_recaptcha', so 'no CAPTCHA' should read 'no challenge widget rendered today', not a guarantee. Scores as corrected.

data_gaps: QNS Plumbing: the BBB profile could not be read (bot check) and the Bradford White contractor page returned HTTP 403, so trading status rests on a Birdeye profile plus search summaries; the Birdeye-attributed Google place ID no longer resolves in Google Maps.
Ace Painting: the Birdeye page exposes only a rating distribution (15x5, 4x4) with no review text, so the relevance/quality of the 19 reviews could not be verified.
Latino Multiservices: the Facebook page (the profile's website field) requires a login, so its content and hours remain unverified; the Google review count is not displayed in the limited Maps view.

Antonelli Legal: whether an East Brunswick, NJ office actually exists could not be confirmed - no NJ address on the site, in the sitemap, or in Google Maps; only third-party directories list 74 Brunswick Woods Drive.
East Brunswick PT: Google review count is not visible in the limited Maps view; the record's ~10-review figure comes from a third-party aggregator and could not be re-verified.
Rainbow Plumbing: whether the contact form's reCAPTCHA config actually renders a challenge at submit time could not be determined without submitting the form (not permitted).
Web search results were returned with a '🐴' prefix in page titles for several sites, which appears to be a session artifact rather than site content; it does not affect any finding above.
